technical.summary: ABBV shows early oversold bounce signals (StochRSI cross, supertrend) but lacks conviction—price remains below all key moving averages, MACD is negative, momentum is weak (ADX 17.71), and Ichimoku cloud provides overhead resistance; high-probability entry requires confirmation above EMA 20/50 with stronger momentum.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal; three small congressional purchases over 86-140 days ago lack conviction, market fear/greed neutral, and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (341), imminent NFP event, and recession signals create highly unfavourable conditions despite distant earnings (85 days).
